name: 直方图梯度分析
description: 分析 直方图 smoothness and gaps 以检测 AI生成的 images 其 often have atypical intensity 分布s.
mechanism: Computes the discrete derivative of the intensity 直方图 and 分析 its smoothness and gap 模式. AI生成的 images often produce unnaturally smooth 直方图s or exhibit specific gap 模式.
parameters: Bins: 256, Derivative: first-order, Smoothness: 方差 of derivative, Gap 检测: zero-run 分析
source: Farid, H. (2016) — Photo Forensics, MIT Press
useCase: Detecting unnatural intensity 分布 模式 in AI content

references.title: Farid, H. (2016). Photo Forensics. MIT Press.

strengths:
• Fast and lightweight computation
• 检测 subtle 分布 异常
• Works 跨 all image formats
• Independent of image content
limitations:
• Lower standalone 准确度
• Post-processing can normalize 直方图s
• Limited for HDR or very dynamic images
• AI models improving at natural 分布s
